# `jouet wind dismiss`

- **Usage:** `jouet wind dismiss <ID>`

Drop a note, a proposal or a suggested review, so it is never shown again

## Arguments
- **`<ID>`** — The id of a note (n3), a proposal (p2), a suggested review (r1) or a mise task (t1)

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
